items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I met her and she told me what's happening and said, you know, he'd never send her no money. And from that day on until I got rid of him, I used to mail her money out every Saturday

ctx.x: He would want to go there periodically? Yeah, to play. To play.

And of course he drew a packed house. He drew all the time around, because all of them knew him around there. So we played there several times. And if I'm not mistaken, I think we played there on our way to Memphis. I'm almost sure we're there. If we're in Nashville, I'm almost sure we're there. That was pretty long ago. Uh-huh. So I think we played that time. And we played there. I met his mother was dead. His grandmother raised her. Uh-huh. Do you remember her name? Huh? I don't remember her name. I really…
It's been quite some time, you know. Was it Jones or what? Do you think it was? I don't remember. Did he have any brothers or sisters?
